meta.title: RFQ bid: Save the bid as a draft and submit later

steps.note: Open the buyer's Responses tab for the prepared live RFQ.
Move to Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Enter the quote and save it as a vendor draft without submitting.

args.text: Your changes have been saved as draft.

steps.note: Confirm the vendor portal reports that the bid was saved as a draft.
Return to the buyer's Responses view to check draft visibility.
Confirm the buyer sees no submitted response while the vendor bid remains a draft.
Return to Vendor A's draft bid.
Submit the saved quote from the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor portal marks the RFQ bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's Responses view after submission.
Confirm the submitted bid now appears as one direct vendor response for the buyer.
